results.name: Belt (Rose) - Character Items (Free)
results.description:
The Sketchfab Store is dead, long live the Sketchfab Store. All free models will still be available for download through Sketchfab. All paid models will be available for sale on Gumroad and inspectable via Sketchfab. 

---
Belt: Rose - This tied belt features lightly patterned material, detailed edge stitches, and a gold buckle. Good for layering in any outfit, but specifically fits over the Rose dress. Offered for free, remixed from the Leather Armor model by @Vahil (CC-BY). Thank you!

--- 
standard specs - 

Fresh, crisp quads, mid-poly resolution. Clothing textures: 4096 diffuse, 4096 normal, 1024 specular. Accessory/hair textures: 2048 diffuse, 2048 normal, 1024 specular. It's debatable whether or not this style qualifies as PBR. It’s high-res, but not hyperrealistic. Partly hand-painted, partly photo-ref materials. Use it in any way that works for you.

FBX format, includes the rest of the armature. My bone names are standardized, but each character has their own custom skeleton (don’t we all?)

This is a true human size and detailed model of a attractive young woman of African appearance dressed in a traditional dress. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization e.g. urban installations, city designs, outdoor design presentations, VR/AR content etc.

**Technical characteristics:**

* digital double 3d scan model
* decimated model (100k triangles)

* PBR textures: Diffuse, Normal, Specular maps
